## ⛔ Not dispatched — this card's own face gates it behind the open product P0/P1 items, and they are open, 2026-09-22T01:20Z

Seat `domain:spec#4` (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917), R20 card selection. ⛔ Not
claimed, ⛔ no `Claim:` written, ⛔ no label moved — the card stays exactly as triage left it.

### The gate, quoted from this card's own body

> Position in the road: step ②「本地跑起来、看到」, records/studio; it is taken **after** the open product
> P0/P1 checklist items by the road order — ⛔ **not dispatched before them**.

### The reading, taken now

| probe | value |
| --- | --- |
| open `priority:p0`, excluding `tooling` | **4** — #12243, #11663, #11632, #2714 |
| open `priority:p1`, excluding `tooling` | **28** |
| of those p1, in this lane and takeable | **0** — #19543 already carries `pm:dispatched`, #18670 is `pm:blocked`, #18215 is an epic |

⇒ the gate is **not** satisfied. ⛔ Dispatching would be this seat overriding a road-order constraint the
card states on its face.

⚠️ **One ambiguity, resolved in the restrictive direction on purpose.** The gate says 「the open product P0/P1
**checklist items**」, which may mean specifically the `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` items rather than every
open P0/P1 card. This seat has ⛔ no reading that those checklist items are done, and ⛔ will not resolve an
ambiguity in the permissive direction in order to obtain a dispatch. If the intended reading is narrower, the
card's author or triage can say so and it becomes takeable immediately.

### Two other things a future claimant should know before reading the scope as a single PR

- **It is not one lane.** Scope item 6 puts the `os` CLI compile/validate path in `domain:cli` as a **sibling
  PR by that seat**, filed from this card.
- **It carries a Tier H half.** The `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` feature-map line plus the two `records-forms`
  checklist items are 「its own small docs PR, the maintainer merges」 — ⛔ that half is never this seat's to
  land.
- ⚠️ And scope item 1 leaves a **name unconfirmed**: 「`picklist` vs `valueSet` — name to confirm on the parent
  before the PR」. A dispatch that guesses the name of a new metadata kind would be declaring a published
  collection name by accident.
